script:
stop_public_cb() { control-agent-server stop --run "$PUBC" >/dev/null } PUBC=$(control-agent-server launch --new --name f19-public-cb --env OH_WEB_URL=https://qa-f19.example/qa-f19 --print-run) trap stop_public_cb EXIT WJ=$(control-agent-server api POST /api/mcp/oauth/start --run "$PUBC" --expect 200 --check ok eq true --save F19.oauth-web-url-precedence/start --field job_id \ --json "$(jq -nc --argjson s "$OAUTH_SRV" --arg cb "$RUN_URL" '{server: $s, timeout: 60, callback_base_url: $cb, tool_call: {name: "read_subject", arguments: {subject: "web"}}}')") control-agent-server api GET "/api/mcp/oauth/status/$WJ" --run "$PUBC" --check callback_ready eq true --until-ok 20 WAU=$(control-agent-server api GET "/api/mcp/oauth/status/$WJ" --run "$PUBC" --field authorization_url) "$PY" -c "$QS_OF" "$WAU" | control-agent-server assert --check redirect_uri eq https://qa-f19.example/qa-f19/api/mcp/oauth/redirect WCB=$(curl -s --noproxy '*' -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' "$WAU") test "${WCB%%\?*}" = https://qa-f19.example/qa-f19/api/mcp/oauth/redirect WQ=$("$PY" -c "$QS_OF" "$WCB") control-agent-server api GET /api/mcp/oauth/redirect --run "$PUBC" --auth none --query "code=$(echo "$WQ" | jq -r .code)" --query "state=$(echo "$WQ" | jq -r .state)" \ --expect 200 --check . contains '

Authorization complete

' --save F19.oauth-web-url-precedence/redirect control-agent-server api GET "/api/mcp/oauth/status/$WJ" --run "$PUBC" --until-ok 30 --save F19.oauth-web-url-precedence/succeeded \ --check status eq succeeded --check tool_result.text eq QA_HTTP_SUBJECT:web --check oauth_state.tokens.access_token matches '^gAAAA' control-agent-server stop --run "$PUBC" trap - EXIT
